run_doom_demo_replay: run a Doom environment demo replay from a given demo path and extract frames
create_doom_env_single_agent: create a single agent Doom environment using make_doom_env with a custom resolution
create_doom_env_multi_agent: create a multi agent Doom environment using make_doom_env_impl with player and bot configuration
extract_frames_from_replay: extract frames from a Doom replay episode and save them as PNG images to a directory
review_main_function: review the main function that replays a Doom episode and logs rewards per frame
